searchText: Could the ExecutionPayload here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/electra/beacon-chain.md#executionpayload get updated to use 7685? It now uses 7002 + 6110 without those EIPs using 7685? the idea was that the CL would just ingest the data from the engine API and then lay it out however it wants i prefer to keep it as-is to reduce spec churn and i think a refactor like this makes a lot of sense after devnet-0 networks
